sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Holiday Inn Express Chengdu Tianfu Airport Zone is in Wanhui Center in Jianyang, opposite Jianyang South station. The free airport shuttle runs to and from the airport from 06:00 to 22:00. Airport pickup points are at exit 12 on the departures floor of Terminal T1 and exit 21 on the departures floor of Terminal T2. Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out by 14:00; the minimum age to check in independently is 18.
